change: All Resonance apps are free during the current costing-validation promotion; new checkout is disabled while usage and delivery costs are measured.
details:
The Hub is operating in a governed free-promotion mode while real usage, provider, storage, rendering, support, and delivery costs are measured. New payment launches are disabled and authenticated users receive promotional access to the available Resonance product capabilities.

Historical SKU and pack catalogs are retained internally so sustainable future pricing can be designed from measured costs rather than assumptions.

change: ePublisher is free during the current promotion while project, narration, and export costs are measured.
details: ePublisher is included in the current free promotion. Users can evaluate the available publishing workflow without a new pack or subscription payment while project, narration, export, storage, and support costs are measured.

change: Creative Studio is free during the current promotion while image, video, and campaign-generation costs are measured.
details: Creative Studio is included in the current free promotion. New paid generation checkout is disabled while actual provider, image, video, storage, and support costs are measured.

change: Sync Vision is free during the current promotion while storyboard, media, and generation costs are measured.
details: Sync Vision is included in the current free promotion. Users can evaluate the available music-video workflow without a new payment while storyboard, media-processing, generation, storage, and support costs are measured.

change: YouTube Optimizer is moving to youtube.reson8.life and remains free during the current costing-validation promotion.
details: YouTube Optimizer remains available during the free promotion while the canonical-domain migration completes. Audit, thumbnail, growth-workflow, provider, and support costs are being measured before future pricing is defined.

change: Free pilot open to schools and learners. Per-report and district packages arrive later in 2026.
details: Career Compass is in an open free pilot for schools, counsellors, and individual learners. The pilot covers career-path discovery, skills mapping, bursary matching, and role-fit insights. Per-report pricing and district/school-wide packages roll out later in 2026 — pilot participants keep free access through the launch.

change: New season live — free episodes, media kits, and shop. Never a subscription.
details: The new season is streaming on the podcast site with free episodes, downloadable media kits, and a merch shop. The podcast is intentionally never gated behind a subscription.

change: Resonance Constitutional Governance Framework v1.0 published — how we build, price, and evolve every app.
details:
RCGF v1.0 is the constitutional framework that governs how every Resonance app is built, priced, and evolved. It codifies our principles around user sovereignty, honest pricing, transparent AI usage, and pass/pack alignment across the ecosystem.

The framework is public, versioned, and referenced directly in the AI prompts that power our optimization protocol.
